thread:
acme_ops_jess: Hi team — after switching to `response_format: json` + `strict: true` our integration started failing with a parse error. Happening for ~30% of requests. Example curl + response below, we need a quick workaround.

acme_ops_jess: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{
  "model": "open-rlhf-2",
  "input": "convert to JSON: name, id",
  "response_format": {"type": "json", "strict": true}
}'

acme_ops_jess: response (200):
{
  "status": "ok",
  "body": "<html>
<head><title>502</title></head>
<body>Bad gateway</body>
</html>"
}

anna_support: Thanks Jess — sorry about the break. Can you paste the `request_id` from the response headers and confirm the model + region? Also did this start after a config change?

acme_ops_jess: request_id: rwd-20260312-8f7a, running model="open-rlhf-2", region=us-west-2. No intentional config changes on our side. Started ~2 hours ago.

mike_eng: quick triage: the response body you pasted looks like an HTML error page wrapped into JSON, which will obviously break `strict` JSON parsing. Two likely causes: upstream proxy returning HTML error, or missing `Accept`/`Content-Type` negotiation so fallback returns an HTML error page.

mike_eng: Can you repro with this curl that sets Accept header and forces raw output?

mike_eng: ```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -H "Accept: application/json" 
  -d '{
    "model": "open-rlhf-2",
    "input": "convert to JSON: name, id",
    "response_format": {"type": "json", "strict": true}
  }'
```

anna_support: Also please try temporarily setting `response_format.strict=false` to confirm it's the strict enforcement tripping the parse. If that works, we'll keep strict off while we investigate.

acme_ops_jess: Tried the curl with `Accept: application/json` — still getting wrapped HTML body for ~1 in 5 calls. When I flip `strict=false` the call succeeds (parses) and returns best-effort JSON.

mike_eng: Good repro, thanks. I'll escalate — seems like intermittent upstream 502s are being proxied and we accidentally marshal the HTML into the JSON wrapper before returning. That is a bug in the error handling path.

mike_eng: Short-term workaround: set `response_format.strict=false` or add client-side retry on parse failures (we'll include a retryable header check). We'll also push a fix to stop embedding raw HTML into the JSON body.

liz_reliability: I've created an incident and pinned the repro logs. Escalating to runtime team. Incident: INC-2026-135. Notified infra pager.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: #INC-2026-135 (priority P2) — assigned to eng-runtime. Logs: https://internal.redwood/incident/INC-2026-135

anna_support: Escalation opened and engineers are on it. For your immediate use-case: keep `strict=false` or implement a quick client-side validation+retry. We'll follow up in this thread once we have a patch and a timeline. Sorry for the disruption. :heart:

acme_ops_jess: Thanks all — `strict=false` is fine for now. Please ping when it's fixed so we can re-enable strict mode for schema validation.

anna_support: Will do. Thanks for the clear repro steps and request_id — super helpful.
